text:
elena: hey @eng-platform, quick question — I opened a PR that touches model-service and platform infra (k8s config). Who's allowed to approve and merge? It's blocked by CODEOWNERS for both folders. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-service/pull/512

tom: can you paste the CODEOWNERS lines? might be easier to see.

elena: sure, relevant snippet:
```
/services/model-service/ @model-service-team @sre
/infra/k8s/   @eng-platform @infra-owners
```

sara: looks like two owners groups. If both are CODEOWNERS, you need at least one approver from each path unless we have a single CODEOWNERS entry covering both. Do the PR files include only a small config change under infra/k8s/overlays/dev?

elena: infra change is a tiny annotation to deployment to enable sidecar debug; model-service change is a companion api shim. Both are necessary to land together.

kevin: if it's cross-area, we usually ask one owner from each group to approve. I can review the model-service code in morning (ETA 0900PT). If @infra-owners can do the k8s toggle then we're good.

julie: infra-owners are out until 10:30PT. If you need unblock sooner, we can use the "override" workflow: add a comment with @eng-platform lead and request an exception. That requires one senior approver to sign off in the thread.

elena: alternative: split PR? Not ideal, changes must land together to avoid config drift.

tom: @kevin will you +1 the model change so infra can merge after their OK? Or we can add @sre/julie to CODEOWNERS for that specific file, but that's risky.

kevin: I'll take an early pass and leave explicit approval if clean. @infra-owners please confirm later.

merge-bot: Deploy checks: all CI passed, no conflicts. /merge requires approvals from: @model-service-team, @infra-owners

elena: ok plan: @kevin please review now; @infra-owners, please review the k8s annotation when you're back. If someone senior from eng-platform (cc @tom) wants to do an override, please reply with :thumbsup: and a short rationale.

sara: noted. tagging @eng-plat-leads for visibility.

kevin: reviewed, minor nits pushed. Approving once CI green. :white_check_mark:

infra-owners: (sre lead) julie: looks fine, annotation scoped to dev. approving. :thumbsup:

elena: thanks everyone. I'll wait for merge-bot then merge tomorrow 0915PT. moving to merge queue.

tom: thanks team. please add a short note in the PR description explaining the paired change so future reviewers see the coupling.

elena: added note. merging after 0915PT if no rollback requests. :rocket:
